notes.title: Lust Academy Final: Major Update is Live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287206/e62da8d51f0d1ef5d62f9d44c25e76a38b22be40.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Over the past few months, we’ve received a lot of feedback from you (our amazing players), and we’ve heard a recurring theme: the ending of Lust Academy left some of you with unanswered questions.[/p][p]So… we’ve decided to fix that.[/p][p]Today, we’re releasing the major update, which adds even more depth to the story and gives you a clearer picture of what really happened at the end of your magical journey. [/p][p]Consider it our way of saying thanks for sticking with us and for caring enough to share your thoughts.[/p][p]What's new in:[/p][list][*][p]15 brand new mini scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Around 200 new renders[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and minor improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the new content, and don’t hesitate to drop us a line, change a review, or leave your thoughts in the discussions![/p][p][i]Love,
Bear in the Night Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Trading Cards & Points Shop Are Live for Lust Academy Final!
notes.content:
[b]Great news, mages![/b]
We’re thrilled to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available for Lust Academy Final!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287206/7a950cf0d65808b2a1c82df220703326a876f910.png[/img]
Collect beautifully illustrated cards featuring your favorite characters, craft badges, and unlock stunning profile backgrounds to show off your magical style.

[b]What’s Included:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trading Cards 
[*] Steam Badge 
[*] Emoticons 
[*] Profile Backgrounds 
[*] Mini Profile Backgrounds 
[*] Animated Profile Backgrounds
[*] Avatar Profile Frame
[*] Animated Avatars.
[/list]
Whether you're a collector or want to add some Lust Academy charm to your Steam experience, now’s the perfect time to jump back in 💜

notes.title: Lust Academy Final is OUT NOW + 2 DLCs + Special Bundles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287206/d7bf3d47c0682963e9ec2af20bc69ac1b2ef9533.png[/img]
[b]Hello, magical friends![/b]
We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Lust Academy Final is now available![/b]

Get ready for the hottest, most dangerous chapter yet. The Overlord is on the move, the Academy is under threat—and your choices will decide who lives, who dies… and who ends up in your bed.

[b]What’s waiting for you:[/b]
[list]
[*] A fiery new adventure with deepened relationships and intense choices
[*] The challenge of strengthening the Academy against a rising darkness
[*] Building powerful alliances with mythical beings
[*] New sandbox elements and enhanced quest systems
[*] Hotter, steamier relationships than ever before!
[/list]

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3626060/Lust_Academy_Season_4__Beyond_the_Veil/]Beyond the Veil[/url] — More intimate moments, renders, animations, Lustogram pictures, mini-comics, and the official soundtracks!

[b]Bundles to Explore with the special prices:[/b]
[list]

[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51884/Lust_Academy_S4_Complete_Edition/]Lust Academy Final: Complete Edition [/url]— Base Game + Beyond the Veil DLC!
[/list]
[b]Jump into the magic, intrigue, and seduction of Lust Academy now![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230990?utm_source=SteamNews style=button] [b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekly DevBlog Update
notes.content:
[i]This is our weekly DevUpdate, and here's the joke of the week:
How do you call a magician who’s incredibly good with cooking?
...
A sauceror![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287206/f9d8efc1b34fdbe12b98c046ab5de4b8429c60f9.jpg[/img]

But, as always, we want to accompany the joke with some helpful information. Here's the list of what we've done in the previous week:
[list]
[*]  Finished 69 renders with Victoria, Samantha, Ashley and June for version 4.6.1
[*]  Finished editing sound design for version 4.5.1
[*]  Retouched 75 renders to maximize their magical atmosphere
[*]  Finished 4 animations for version 4.6.1
[*]  Finished fixing some bugs and errors in version 4.5.1a
[/list]

That's it for today! Stay tuned for more information, and have a great week!

[i]Sincerely, 
Bear in the Night team[/i]
